question: Should retirement of the unshipped Workspaces beta include core Doctor cleanup for manually enabled users, with an ordinary Doctor finding before the explicit repair deletes state?
rationale: The implementation choice affects beta-user recovery and deletion semantics; tests cannot determine the intended product policy for visible warning versus silent repair-only cleanup.

options.title: Require visible detection before repair
options.body: Show a normal Doctor finding and dry-run-safe repair preview, then allow `--fix` to remove only the retired plugin state.

options.title: Keep repair-only cleanup
options.body: Accept that users learn about the retired state only when invoking the repair path and document that deliberate behavior.

recommendation.title: Require visible detection before repair
recommendation.body: Show a normal Doctor finding and dry-run-safe repair preview, then allow `--fix` to remove only the retired plugin state.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history connects this contributor directly to the removal and Doctor-retirement design.
